en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, ornate neoclassical building identified in Hungarian as the Palace of Justice. Above and to the right is a graphic design of a stylized sun with long radiating rays. The printed caption on the photo names the city as Kolozsvár, with additional Hungarian text under the image. The scene appears to be an official judicial/government building in an open square or wide street.
